title: servers/<community>.json
description: The server naming rules of one community, <community> being its ID in NERV's global settings, in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations. The site takes a merged version only when every file passes this schema and the checks it cannot express: variables, duplicate rules, addresses, labels and marks, and labels server-labels.json does not have.

address.description: The server's connect address as the site shows it

labels.description: IDs of server-labels.json's labels for the server, in the order they show; a language whose name the entry gives shows them next to the name

names.description: The names by language: en, zh-CN, ja, ko. A language left out shows the original name; zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN

rules.description: The naming rules; the first whose match is a server's whole original name gives its names

servers.description: Names of single servers by their address; they come before the rules

label.description: The ID of the label the mark becomes, after the rule's labels; left out, the mark is dropped

text.description: The mark as the community writes it, compared exactly; it is taken out wherever it is in the name, with the space next to it

labels.description: IDs of server-labels.json's labels for the servers the rule names, in the order they show; a language whose name the rule gives shows them next to the name

marks.description: Temporary marks the community puts in its servers' original names, such as [已人满]; each is taken out of the name before the match is compared, and is dropped or becomes a label. A server no rule matches shows its original name, marks and all

match.description: A whole original name, compared exactly, in which {variable} stands for text that varies (at least one character); {{ and }} are literal braces. The rule's marks are taken out of the name before it is compared

names.description: The names by language: en, zh-CN, ja, ko. A language left out shows the original name; zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN
